description: Delete one NACE industry-monitoring subscription by its id (from list_my_subscriptions); Firmaradar then stops delivering webhooks for that industry. The subscription must belong to the authenticated user. Idempotent — deleting an id that is already gone returns already_absent=true rather than an error. Reversible only by re-subscribing. Call only when the user has asked to stop monitoring an industry.

subscription_id.description: The id of the subscription to delete (from list_my_subscriptions). Must belong to the authenticated user.
subscription_id.title: Subscription Id

name: firmaradar_delete_subscription

already_absent.description: True if no subscription with that id existed for the user (nothing to delete).
already_absent.title: Already Absent

deleted.description: True if the subscription was removed.
deleted.title: Deleted

title: Delete Industry Subscription
